title: abilityitems
description: a plugin that alows u to add abilities to items
body:
Commands:
/abilityitems create [itemname] [material] 
/abilityitems ability add|remove [itemname] [clicktype] [ability]
/abilityitems cooldown [itemname] [clicktype] [in s]
/abilityitems enchant [itemname] add|remove [enchant] [level 1-255]
/abilityitems [itemname] give [player]
/abilityitems rename [itemname] [newname] 
/abilityitems disable
/abilityitems enable
/abilityitems list
/abilityitems reload 
Abilities (20 total configurable in config.yml): 
Dash 
cobweb place|break
earthquake
pull
frezze
warden sonic
...
